shortcut_name: k selections force one protocol per resource value
evidence: "Sort materials by number of options" and "All materials are distinct"; "finding a matching of size"
affordance_in_statement: You must select exactly **k** protocols ... **k** distinct raw materials ... No two chosen protocols may use the same raw material.
removal_suggestion: There is no wording-only removal that preserves the task: selecting k items from k resource values with pairwise distinct usage intrinsically forces every resource value to be used once. Re-presenting the resources under scenario-specific names would only obscure, not remove, this structure.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Groups protocols by material and searches for one protocol from every material while tracking used catalysts and treatments.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: "Group by material" and "Sort materials by number of options"

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Reduces the requirement to a size-k matching/permutation problem over the three protocol coordinates.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: "This is equivalent to finding a matching of size"

common_affordance: Because exactly k protocols must be chosen from k possible values in each coordinate and repetitions are forbidden, every valid solution necessarily contains each material, catalyst, and treatment exactly once.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its exact-cover formulation is appropriate, but the DLX implementation has an implementation-level bookkeeping or output bug; the visible construction of three columns per protocol is not itself a conceptual solution error.
The split-half meet-in-the-middle implementation is not robust on the maximum dense instances and terminates with a runtime error, despite the half partition itself being valid.

recommended_edit: No effective edit is available without changing the mathematical task: the shared affordance is an intrinsic consequence of the immutable cardinalities and diversity condition. Any attempt to hide it in scenario wording would still leave the same forced structure.
regression_risk: Any performance-oriented edit that changes the search presentation rather than the task could accidentally make the already-defeated DLX or meet-in-the-middle implementations pass.
